build_notes: NE2025 (Ocker & Cordes 2026) via mwprop 2.0.5, physics unchanged. Each sightline integrated once to mwprop's 50 kpc limit on mwprop's own grids (0.1 kpc smooth / 0.0025 kpc small-scale), tools/ne2025_fast.py; agrees with direct ne2025() calls to <1% (89 random points: max 0.34% in D, 0.93% in tau). dm_max = DM to the model edge; tau_x = mwprop TAU_X (extragalactic plane-wave broadening of the full column). dist/tau = DM->D distance and Galactic-source pulse broadening (mwprop TAU) at each dm_grid value; for DM > dm_max they are clamped to the model-edge values (mwprop's lower-limit distance). tau at 1 GHz in ms, floored at 1e-12 ms; scale as nu^-4.4. All sightlines computed (no declination skip). Interpolate with tools/build_ne2025_grid.py:interp_grid.
encoding: base64 little-endian int16 of round(1000*log10(x)), delta-encoded along the last axis (cumsum along last axis to decode), C order
